d: We are seeking an experienced and strategic Procurement Director to lead procurement activities, optimize sourcing strategies, and strengthen supplier relationships. The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership abilities, commercial awareness, and excellent negotiation skills to ensure cost-effective purchasing and reliable supply chain operations.
Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business objectives.
Oversee purchasing activities, sourcing operations, and supplier management.
Identify, evaluate, and establish relationships with reliable suppliers and vendors.
Lead contract negotiations to secure competitive pricing and favorable terms.
Monitor procurement budgets, spending, and cost-saving opportunities.
Establish procurement policies, procedures, and internal controls.
Evaluate supplier performance, delivery standards, and product quality.
Manage procurement risks and address supply chain challenges.
Coordinate with finance, operations, and other departments to meet purchasing requirements.
Oversee tender processes, quotations, and supplier selection.
Monitor market trends and identify opportunities for strategic sourcing.
Prepare procurement reports and present performance updates to senior management.
Drive continuous improvement in procurement efficiency and cost management.
Strong knowledge of procurement, purchasing, and supply chain management.
Excellent negotiation, leadership, and decision-making skills.
Understanding of supplier evaluation and contract management.
Strong financial awareness and budget management capabilities.
Excellent analytical and strategic planning abilities.
Ability to manage multiple procurement priorities.
Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
High standards of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.
Opportunities to lead strategic procurement initiatives.
Exposure to supplier networks and business operations.
Opportunities to influence cost optimization and business growth.
🚀 Strategic Sourcing. Strong Partnerships. Smarter Procurement!
If you are passionate about procurement leadership, supplier management, and driving business efficiency, we would love to hear from you!
